## Summary

What problem does this solve, and why is this approach appropriate?

## Testing

What automated and manual checks were run?

## Compatibility

Does this change affect configuration, report schemas, Action inputs, CLI output, or supported runtimes?

## Security

Does this change affect token permissions, trusted configuration, patch parsing, secret redaction, or `pull_request_target` behavior?

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests or fixtures cover the change
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] Recovery guidance is actionable
- [ ] The change does not profile contributors or infer intent
- [ ] The changelog is updated when user-visible behavior changes
